defensiveAbilities.name: Attack of Opportunity
defensiveAbilities.description:
See rules...

Trigger A creature within the monster's reach uses a manipulate action or a move action, makes a ranged attack, or leaves a square during a move action it's using.

Effect The monster attempts a melee Strike against the triggering creature. If the attack is a critical hit and the trigger was a manipulate action, the monster disrupts that action. This Strike doesn't count toward the monster's multiple attack penalty, and its multiple attack penalty doesn't apply to this Strike.

offensiveAbilities.name: Constrict (Grabbed by Claws only)
offensiveAbilities.description:
(1d8+12) Bludgeoning Damage damage, Basic DC 28 Fortitude Saving Throw

See rules...

The monster deals the listed amount of damage to any number of creatures Grabbed or Restrained by it. Each of those creatures can attempt a basic Fortitude save with the listed DC.

offensiveAbilities.name: Draining Venom
offensiveAbilities.description:
Saving Throw DC 28 Fortitude Saving Throw

Maximum Duration 6 rounds

Stage 1 drained 1 (1 round)

Stage 2 drained 2 (1 round)

offensiveAbilities.name: Mind Feeding
offensiveAbilities.description:
Requirements A drained creature is grabbed by the chuul's tentacles

Effect The creature takes 3d6 Mental Damage damage.

offensiveAbilities.name: Swamp Stride
offensiveAbilities.description: The Voidbracken chuul ignores difficult terrain and greater difficult terrain in swamps.

offensiveAbilities.name: Tentacle Transfer
offensiveAbilities.description:
Requirements The Voidbracken chuul has a creature grabbed

Effect The chuul transfers the grabbed creature from its claws to its tentacles, or vice versa. The creature is exposed to the chuul's draining venom when transferred into the tentacles and at the start of each of the chuul's turns if it remains grabbed by the tentacles.

offensiveAbilities.name: Grab
offensiveAbilities.description:
See rules...

Requirements The monster's last action was a successful Strike that lists Grab in its damage entry, or the monster has a creature Grabbed or Restrained

Effect If used after a Strike, the monster attempts to Grapple the creature using the body part it attacked with. This attempt neither applies nor counts toward the creature's multiple attack penalty.

The monster can instead use Grab and choose one creature it's grabbing or restraining with an appendage that has Grab to automatically extend that condition to the end of the monster's next turn.
